Record that a unit was searched, and by which search

Source: R/blast_genbank.R
mark_unit_searched.Rd

Record that a unit was searched, and by which search

Usage

mark_unit_searched(
  con,
  id,
  path = 1L,
  scaffold = 1L,
  query_md5,
  n_hits = 0L,
  source = "remote",
  db = ""
)

Arguments

con

Open project DB connection.

id

Sample ID.

path, scaffold

Assembly unit within the sample.

query_md5

md5 of the query sequence and the search settings, as blast.nf computes it.

n_hits

Number of hits the search returned.

source

Which search produced the hits, "local" or "remote".

db

The database that answered: "core_nt", or the local panel's name and release.

Value

(invisibly) TRUE.
